input.title: V05 Nilagiri Phytolabs: no reply, issues exhausted, compliance docs outstanding
input.detail:
Nilagiri Phytolabs LLP (Prakash) did not reply by the 14 Nov 2026 deadline after two clarification emails, a reminder and a final request. All open rule-engine issues have 0 tries left, so no further automated ask is permitted:
- RM-002 Glycerin: MOQ not stated; shelf life not stated.
- RM-005 Caffeine: lot size in kg unclear ("one full lot"); shelf life not stated.
Unresolved compliance items from our requirements (no answer on file): current SDS with transport hazard class, pre-award COA, and confirmation of leave-on scalp cosmetic suitability under the Cosmetics Rules 2020. The vendor's only compliance statement is that a COA is available after order, which conflicts with our pre-award requirement. Their certificates are reported as under renewal.
Quoted prices on file: Glycerin Rs118/kg; Rosemary extract Rs7000/kg (MOQ 100 kg); Caffeine Rs1650/kg if one full lot; freight about Rs9/kg extra; 50% advance terms; 3-week delivery.
Decision needed: whether to close V05 out for RFx KPC-2026-014, or to allow a further contact outside the rule-engine limits (for example a phone call). Note that the knockout gaps listed in memory (H1, B5, H2) do not appear in the current gap list, so please confirm their status.
